studies.name: Continuous spread
studies.structure: An unboxed continuous editorial spread: prose, large facts, flowing columns and marginal personal annotations share a single reading canvas. Avoid a two-column hero followed by numbered sections. Native vertical reading with an editorial contents index; wide type/columns collapse into a deliberately re-composed linear phone essay. No card slabs.
